datasets.title: IGAD Region - Monthly Combined Drought Indicator(CDI) 2022
datasets.description: Monthly Combined Drought Indicator (CDI) as implemented in the East Africa Drought Watch, and which is used for detecting and monitoring areas that either are affected or have the potential to be affected by meteorological, agricultural and/or hydrological drought.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/igad-region-monthly-combined-drought-indicator-cdi-2022]

contact_point.name: IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Center (ICPAC)

creator.name: IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Center (ICPAC)

lineage.description: Monthly CDI rasters were generated by ICPAC using the East Africa Drought Watch methodology, which combines multiple drought indicators to detect and monitor meteorological, agricultural, and hydrological drought conditions across the IGAD region. The dataset comprises 11 monthly GeoTIFF files covering January through December 2022, providing spatially explicit drought hazard assessment for early warning and monitoring purposes.

sources.name: IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Center (ICPAC)
sources.description: East Africa Drought Watch Combined Drought Indicator methodology that integrates meteorological, agricultural, and hydrological drought detection and monitoring across the IGAD region
